create_llama_model: create a LLaMA TransformerLM model from an LLaMAConfig using the create_llama_model factory function
create_llama_embedding: create a vocab-sharded or sharded embedding layer with truncated normal initialization for a LLaMA model
create_llama_decoder: create a StandardTransformerLMDecoder with rotary position encoding and multiple decoder layers for LLaMA
create_llama_self_attention: create a StandardMultiheadAttention layer with causal bias and rotary position encoding for a LLaMA decoder
init_llama_rope_freqs: initialize scaled RoPE frequency tensors for extended context length using linear interpolation between low and high frequency factors
